core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Cosmetics and Skincare; Daily Necessities; Food and Beverages; Private Label Goods
specialty_focus: Tsuruha Holdings is a major Japanese retail enterprise operating a community-based chain of drugstores and dispensing pharmacies. It focuses on community health, everyday convenience, and accessible self-care, offering pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and health-related products. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
